analysis.evidence: The plural verb agrees with כָּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד, “all the days of Jared.” The numerical predicate gives the length of his life as 962 years.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine plural, with prefixed וַ־
analysis.sense: to amount to a stated total

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד, “all the days of Jared,” כָּל takes Jared’s days together as a single span. The verse gives their total as 962 years.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, masculine singular construct, with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד, “all the days of Jared,” the construct form יְמֵי links “days” to Jared. The verse gives their total as 962 years and closes with וַיָּמֹת, “and he died,” so the days comprise his entire lifespan.
analysis.sense: (pl.) days of a life, a reign or an age

draft.change: Add a personal-name article for יֶרֶד linked to the consonantal root ירד.
draft.definition: Jared is the personal name of Mahalalel’s son in Genesis 5:15.
draft.evidence: וַיּוֹלֶד אֶת יָרֶד means “he fathered Jared.” The genealogy identifies the bearer and gives no explanation of the name’s origin.

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד, “all the days of Jared,” the name completes the construct phrase. The verse totals Jared’s lifespan at 962 years and records his death, closing the account of Mahalalel’s son introduced in Genesis 5:15.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular proper noun in the absolute state, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, “sixty-two years,” שְׁתַּיִם supplies the two units and agrees in gender with the feminine noun שָׁנָה.
In שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, the marked word adds sixty to two, giving sixty-two years. The following nine hundred years brings Jared’s lifespan to 962 years.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וְ prefixed to a cardinal numeral, plural absolute, common gender.

analysis.evidence: In שְׁתַּיִם וְשִׁשִּׁים שָׁנָה, the marked noun gives the unit for sixty-two. The verse adds nine hundred years to give the total for כָּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד, “all the days of Jared,” before recording his death.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, feminine singular absolute, without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, תְּשַׁע counts nine hundreds and שָׁנָה supplies the unit. These nine hundred years combine with the preceding sixty-two to give Jared’s lifespan of 962 years.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, plural absolute, without prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: hundreds (plural מֵאוֹת, with the digits: three hundred to nine hundred)

analysis.evidence: In וּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, “and nine hundred years,” the marked noun supplies the unit for the final nine hundred of Jared’s 962 years. כָּל יְמֵי יֶרֶד, “all the days of Jared,” identifies the total as his lifespan.
After giving Jared’s lifespan as 962 years, the verse closes with וַיָּמֹת. Jared is the subject of the singular verb.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with prefixed וַ־.
